Title: List Contacts
Description: List CRM contacts (subscribers) with optional filtering by status, tags, lists, and search. Supports pagination.

Title: Get Contact
Description: Get detailed information about a single contact including their tags, lists, custom fields, and activity history.

Title: Get Contact by Email
Description: Look up a contact by their email address. Returns the full contact record if found.

Title: Create Contact
Description: Create a new CRM contact. Email is required. You can assign tags and lists at creation time.

Title: Update Contact
Description: Update an existing contact. Pass only the fields you want to change. Does not modify tags or lists (use dedicated tag/list tools).

Title: Delete Contact
Description: Permanently delete a contact from the CRM. This removes all associated data including tags, lists, and activity history.

Title: Add Tags to Contact
Description: Add one or more tags to a contact. Existing tags are preserved.

Title: Remove Tags from Contact
Description: Remove one or more tags from a contact.

Title: List Tags
Description: List all CRM tags. Tags are used to categorize and segment contacts for targeted campaigns and automations.

Title: Create Tag
Description: Create a new CRM tag for categorizing contacts.

Title: Update Tag
Description: Update an existing tag name, slug, or description.

Title: Delete Tag
Description: Permanently delete a tag. Contacts that had this tag will have it removed, but the contacts themselves are not deleted.

Title: Attach Tag to Contact
Description: Attach a tag to one or more contacts by their subscriber IDs. This is an alternative to fluentcrm_contact_add_tags when you want to work from the tag perspective.

Title: List Lists
Description: List all CRM lists (mailing lists). Lists are used to organize contacts into groups for campaigns and segmentation.

Title: Create List
Description: Create a new mailing list for organizing contacts.

Title: Update List
Description: Update an existing list name, slug, or description.

Title: Delete List
Description: Permanently delete a list. Contacts in this list are not deleted, but their association with this list is removed.

Title: Add Contact to List
Description: Add one or more contacts to a mailing list by their subscriber IDs.

Title: List Campaigns
Description: List email campaigns with optional filtering by status. Returns campaign summaries including send stats.

Title: Get Campaign
Description: Get detailed information about a single campaign including its settings, recipients, email body, and performance stats.

Title: Create Campaign
Description: Create a new email campaign in draft status. You can specify the subject, body, recipients (by tags/lists), and template.

Title: Schedule Campaign
Description: Schedule a draft campaign for sending. You must specify the recipients (by tags/lists) and optionally a send date. If no date is given, the campaign will be sent immediately.

Title: Pause Campaign
Description: Pause a currently sending (working) campaign. Can be resumed later.

Title: Resume Campaign
Description: Resume a paused campaign to continue sending.

Title: List Templates
Description: List all email templates. Templates provide reusable email layouts and designs for campaigns.

Title: Get Template
Description: Get detailed information about a specific email template including its HTML body and design settings.

Title: Create Template
Description: Create a new email template with HTML content. Templates can be used across multiple campaigns.

Title: List Sequences
Description: List all email sequences (Pro). Sequences are automated multi-step email drip campaigns sent on a schedule.

Title: Get Sequence
Description: Get detailed information about a specific sequence including its emails, delays, and subscriber count.

Title: Add Subscriber to Sequence
Description: Add one or more contacts to a sequence. They will start receiving the sequence emails from the beginning.

Title: Remove Subscriber from Sequence
Description: Remove one or more contacts from a sequence. They will stop receiving further emails.

Title: List Automations/Funnels
Description: List all automation funnels. Funnels are multi-step workflows triggered by events (signup, tag added, purchase, etc.).

Title: Get Automation/Funnel
Description: Get detailed information about a specific funnel including all its steps, triggers, and subscriber metrics.

Title: Create Automation/Funnel
Description: Create a new automation funnel. Funnels start in draft status. Add triggers and actions, then publish to activate.

Title: Trigger Funnel for Contact
Description: Manually trigger a funnel for a specific contact via the webhook endpoint. The contact will enter the funnel as if the trigger event had occurred.

Title: Get Dashboard Stats
Description: Get CRM dashboard statistics: total contacts, active subscribers, unsubscribed, emails sent, open rate, click rate, and more.

Title: Get Subscribers Growth
Description: Get subscriber growth trends over time. Shows new subscribers per day/week/month in the given date range.

Title: Get Campaign Stats
Description: Get aggregated campaign performance statistics: emails sent, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, bounces, and revenue attribution.

Title: List Webhooks
Description: List all configured incoming webhooks. Webhooks allow external systems to create or update contacts and trigger automations in FluentCRM.

Title: Create Webhook
Description: Create a new incoming webhook endpoint. The webhook URL can be used by external systems to push data into FluentCRM (contacts, tags, lists, funnels).

Title: List Tickets
Description: List support tickets with optional filtering by status, priority, agent, customer, and product. Supports pagination and search.

Title: Get Ticket
Description: Get detailed information about a single support ticket including its current status, priority, assigned agent, customer, tags, and conversation history.

Title: Create Ticket
Description: Create a new support ticket. Requires a title, email (customer email), and content. Optionally assign an agent, priority, and product.

Title: Update Ticket
Description: Update ticket properties such as priority, agent assignment, product, or status. Pass only the fields you want to change.

Title: Reply to Ticket
Description: Add a response/reply to a ticket. The content supports HTML. You can add internal notes by setting is_internal to true.

Title: Close Ticket
Description: Close an open ticket. Changes the ticket status to "closed".

Title: Reopen Ticket
Description: Reopen a closed ticket. Changes the ticket status back to "active".

Title: Delete Ticket
Description: Permanently delete a ticket. This action cannot be undone. All responses and attachments will also be deleted.

Title: Bulk Ticket Actions
Description: Perform bulk operations on multiple tickets. Supported actions: close, reopen, delete, assign_agent, change_priority.

Title: List Ticket Responses
Description: Get all responses/replies for a specific ticket. Returns the full conversation thread including internal notes.

Title: Add Tag to Ticket
Description: Add one or more tags to a ticket.

Title: Remove Tag from Ticket
Description: Remove a tag from a ticket.

Title: List Customers
Description: List support customers with optional search and pagination. Customers are the people who submit tickets.

Title: Get Customer
Description: Get detailed customer information including their support history, ticket count, and profile data.

Title: Create Customer
Description: Create a new support customer. Email is required and must be unique. The customer can then submit tickets.

Title: Update Customer
Description: Update customer profile fields. Fetches current state first to ensure required fields are preserved.

Title: Delete Customer
Description: Permanently delete a customer. This will NOT delete their tickets, but will disassociate them.

Title: Get Customer Tickets
Description: List all tickets submitted by a specific customer. Useful for viewing support history.

Title: List Agents
Description: List all support agents/staff members. Agents handle ticket responses and manage the helpdesk.

Title: Get Agent
Description: Get detailed information about a specific agent including their stats and settings.

Title: Create Agent
Description: Create a new support agent. The user_id must correspond to an existing WordPress user.

Title: Update Agent
Description: Update agent profile information such as name, email, or title.

Title: Delete Agent
Description: Remove an agent from the support team. This does not delete the underlying WordPress user. Open tickets may need to be reassigned.

Title: Get Overall Stats
Description: Get overall support statistics: total tickets, open tickets, closed tickets, average response time, and resolution time.

Title: Get Ticket Growth
Description: Get ticket creation trends over time. Shows how many tickets were created per day, week, or month in the given date range.

Title: Get Resolution Stats
Description: Get ticket resolution statistics: average time to resolve, resolution rate, and breakdown by priority.

Title: Get Response Stats
Description: Get response time statistics: average first response time, average response time, and response count breakdown.

Title: Get Agent Performance Stats
Description: Get per-agent performance metrics: tickets handled, average response time, resolution count, and satisfaction scores.

Title: Get Personal Stats
Description: Get personal support stats for the authenticated agent: your tickets, response times, and resolution metrics.

Title: List Workflows
Description: List all automation workflows. Workflows automate ticket routing, auto-replies, SLA enforcement, and other support actions.

Title: Get Workflow
Description: Get detailed information about a specific workflow including its triggers, conditions, and actions.

Title: Create Workflow
Description: Create a new automation workflow. Define triggers, conditions, and actions to automate support processes.

Title: Update Workflow
Description: Update an existing workflow. Can modify triggers, conditions, actions, status, or metadata.

Title: Delete Workflow
Description: Permanently delete a workflow. Active workflows should be deactivated first.

Title: List Saved Replies
Description: List all saved reply templates. Saved replies are pre-written response templates that agents can quickly insert when replying to tickets.

Title: Get Saved Reply
Description: Get full details of a specific saved reply template including its content.

Title: Create Saved Reply
Description: Create a new saved reply template. Use dynamic placeholders like {{customer.name}}, {{ticket.title}} for personalized responses.

Title: Update Saved Reply
Description: Update an existing saved reply template. Pass only the fields to change.

Title: Delete Saved Reply
Description: Permanently delete a saved reply template.

Title: List Tags
Description: List all ticket tags. Tags help categorize and organize tickets for filtering and reporting.

Title: Create Tag
Description: Create a new ticket tag for categorizing tickets.

Title: Update Tag
Description: Update an existing tag name or description.

Title: Delete Tag
Description: Permanently delete a tag. Existing ticket associations will be removed.

Title: List Products
Description: List all products. Products can be associated with tickets to track which product a support request is about.

Title: Create Product
Description: Create a new product for ticket categorization.

Title: Update Product
Description: Update an existing product name or description.

Title: Delete Product
Description: Permanently delete a product. Existing ticket associations will be removed.

Title: Get Settings
Description: Get Fluent Support general settings: business hours, email notifications, ticket defaults, and more.

Title: Get Mailboxes
Description: List all configured mailboxes/inboxes. Mailboxes determine where incoming ticket emails are received.

Title: List Activities
Description: List recent activity log entries. Activities track all actions performed on tickets, customers, and agents (replies, status changes, assignments, etc.).

Title: List Boards
Description: List all project boards with optional filtering by type, search, and pagination. Boards are the top-level containers for stages and tasks.

Title: Get Board
Description: Get detailed information about a single board including its stages, settings, and metadata.

Title: Create Board
Description: Create a new project board. Requires a title and type (to-do or roadmap). Optionally include a description, currency, folder, and initial stages.

Title: Update Board
Description: Update board properties such as title or description. Pass only the fields you want to change.

Title: Delete Board
Description: Permanently delete a board. This action cannot be undone. All stages, tasks, and associated data will also be deleted.

Title: Archive Board
Description: Archive a board. Archived boards can be restored later.

Title: List Tasks
Description: List all tasks for a specific board. Returns tasks across all stages with their status, priority, assignees, and metadata.

Title: Get Task
Description: Get detailed information about a single task including its description, assignees, labels, subtasks, and activity history.

Title: Create Task
Description: Create a new task on a board. Requires a title, board_id, and stage_id. Optionally set priority, CRM contact, or mark as template.

Title: Update Task
Description: Update a specific property of a task. Supported properties: title, description, status, priority, due_at, started_at, assignees, archived_at, last_completed_at, board_id, type, reminder_type, remind_at.

Title: Delete Task
Description: Permanently delete a task. This action cannot be undone. All subtasks, comments, and attachments will also be deleted.

Title: Move Task to Stage
Description: Move a task to a different stage within the same board, or to a stage in a different board. Optionally set the position within the target stage.

Title: Clone Task
Description: Create a copy of an existing task. Choose which elements to include: assignees, subtasks, labels, attachments, and comments.

Title: Close Task
Description: Close (complete) a task by setting its status to "closed" and recording the completion timestamp.

Title: List Archived Stages
Description: List archived stages for a board. Active stages are returned as part of the board details (use board_get). This endpoint returns only archived/soft-deleted stages.

Title: Create Stage
Description: Create a new stage (column) on a board. The stage is added at the end by default, or at the specified position.

Title: Update Stage
Description: Update stage properties such as title or settings.

Title: Archive Stage
Description: Archive (soft-delete) a stage. The stage and its tasks are hidden but can be restored later.

Title: Reorder Stages
Description: Update the positions of multiple stages at once. Pass an array of stage IDs in the desired order.

Title: List Labels
Description: List all labels for a specific board. Labels help categorize and visually tag tasks.

Title: Create Label
Description: Create a new label for a board. Requires a color and background color in hex format. Optionally provide a label title.

Title: Update Label
Description: Update an existing label. You can change its title, text color, or background color.

Title: Delete Label
Description: Permanently delete a label from a board. Existing task associations will be removed.

Title: Assign Label to Task
Description: Assign a label to a task on a board.

Title: List Task Comments
Description: List all comments for a specific task. Returns the conversation thread including replies.

Title: Create Comment
Description: Add a new comment to a task. Supports threaded replies via parent_id.

Title: Delete Comment
Description: Delete a comment from a task. This also removes any threaded replies and attachments.

Title: List Board Members
Description: List all members of a specific board including their roles (admin, member, viewer).

Title: Add Member to Board
Description: Add a user to a board as a member or viewer. The user must already exist in WordPress.

Title: Remove Member from Board
Description: Remove a user from a board. Their task assignments on this board may need reassignment.

Title: List Spaces
Description: List all community spaces (groups/forums). Spaces are the main containers for posts and discussions. Supports pagination and search.

Title: Get Space
Description: Get detailed information about a specific space including its settings, member count, privacy level, and description.

Title: Create Space
Description: Create a new community space. Spaces can be public (anyone can join), private (invite-only), or secret (hidden from non-members).

Title: Update Space
Description: Update space properties such as title, description, privacy level, or status. Pass only the fields you want to change.

Title: Delete Space
Description: Permanently delete a space. This will remove all posts, comments, and member associations within the space. This action cannot be undone.

Title: List Feeds/Posts
Description: List community posts/feeds with optional filtering by space, author, and status. Supports pagination and search. Returns post content, author info, reactions, and comment counts.

Title: Get Feed/Post
Description: Get detailed information about a single post including its full content, author, reactions, comments, and metadata.

Title: Create Feed/Post
Description: Create a new post/feed in a community space. Requires a space_id and message content. Posts can be published immediately or saved as drafts.

Title: Update Feed/Post
Description: Update an existing post. Can modify content, title, status, pinned state, or comment settings. Pass only the fields you want to change.

Title: Delete Feed/Post
Description: Permanently delete a post and all its associated comments. This action cannot be undone.

Title: Search Feeds/Posts
Description: Search across all community posts by keyword. Returns matching posts with relevance ranking. More targeted than feed_list with search parameter.

Title: List Comments
Description: List comments for a specific post/feed. Returns comment content, author info, and nested replies. Supports pagination.

Title: Create Comment
Description: Add a comment to a post/feed. Supports threaded replies by specifying a parent_id for the comment being replied to.

Title: Update Comment
Description: Update the content of an existing comment. Only the comment author or administrators can update a comment.

Title: Delete Comment
Description: Permanently delete a comment. If the comment has replies, they will also be removed. This action cannot be undone.

Title: List Members
Description: List community members with optional search and pagination. Shows member profiles, roles, and activity status.

Title: Get Member
Description: Get detailed profile information about a specific community member including their activity, spaces, and role.

Title: Add Member to Space
Description: Add a user to a community space. The user must be a WordPress user. You can optionally set their role within the space.

Title: Remove Member from Space
Description: Remove a user from a community space. The user will lose access to the space content if it is private or secret.

Title: Update Member Role
Description: Change a member's role within a specific space. Roles control permissions: member (read/post), moderator (manage posts/comments), admin (full control).

Title: List Courses
Description: List all courses in the community. Courses are structured learning paths with lessons and optional quizzes. Supports pagination.

Title: Get Course
Description: Get detailed information about a specific course including its lessons, enrollment count, progress tracking, and metadata.

Title: Enroll User in Course
Description: Enroll a user in a course. The user will gain access to all published lessons within the course.

Title: Unenroll User from Course
Description: Remove a user's enrollment from a course. Their progress data may be retained but they will lose access to lessons.

Title: List Notifications
Description: List notifications for the authenticated user. Shows mentions, replies, reactions, and other community activity notifications. Supports pagination.

Title: Mark Notifications as Read
Description: Mark one or more notifications as read. Pass specific notification IDs or omit to mark all unread notifications as read.

Title: Get Community Stats
Description: Get overall community statistics: total members, total spaces, total posts, total comments, active members, new sign-ups, and engagement metrics.

Title: Get Activity Analytics
Description: Get community activity trends over time: posts created, comments made, new members, and reactions. Useful for tracking engagement and growth.

Title: Get Community Settings
Description: Get Fluent Community configuration settings: general settings, registration options, email notifications, storage configuration, and authentication settings.

Title: Update Community Settings
Description: Update Fluent Community configuration settings. Pass a settings group and the key-value pairs to update. Only provided fields will be changed.

Title: List Affiliates
Description: List all affiliates with optional filtering by status, search, and pagination. Returns affiliate profiles including earnings, referral counts, and status.

Title: Get Affiliate
Description: Get detailed information about a single affiliate including their profile, earnings summary, referral stats, payout history, and visit data.

Title: Create Affiliate
Description: Create a new affiliate. Requires a WordPress user ID or email. The affiliate will be associated with the given user account.

Title: Update Affiliate
Description: Update affiliate profile fields such as payment email, status, or referral URL. Pass only the fields you want to change.

Title: Delete Affiliate
Description: Permanently delete an affiliate. This removes the affiliate record but does not delete the WordPress user account. Existing referrals may be affected.

Title: Update Affiliate Status
Description: Change the status of an affiliate (approve, reject, block, or reactivate). Use this for affiliate application management.

Title: List Referrals
Description: List all referrals with optional filtering by affiliate, status, type, and date range. Returns referral details including commission amounts and associated orders.

Title: Get Referral
Description: Get detailed information about a single referral including the associated affiliate, order reference, commission amount, and status.

Title: Create Referral
Description: Manually create a new referral record. Useful for crediting affiliates for offline sales or custom referral scenarios.

Title: Delete Referral
Description: Permanently delete a referral record. This cannot be undone. The affiliate earnings will be adjusted accordingly.

Title: List Payouts
Description: List all payout records with optional filtering by status, affiliate, and date range. Shows payout amounts, methods, and processing status.

Title: Get Payout
Description: Get detailed information about a specific payout including the affiliate, amount, payment method, status, and associated transactions.

Title: Process Payout
Description: Process a payout for one or more affiliates. This marks approved referrals as paid and creates a payout record. Provide affiliate IDs to include in the payout batch.

Title: Validate Payout Configuration
Description: Validate that the payout configuration is correctly set up before processing payouts. Checks payment method settings, minimum thresholds, and affiliate payment details.

Title: List Visits
Description: List affiliate link visits/clicks with optional filtering by affiliate, date range, and pagination. Shows referral URL, landing page, IP (if stored), and conversion status.

Title: Get Dashboard Stats
Description: Get affiliate program dashboard statistics: total affiliates, total referrals, total earnings, unpaid commissions, total visits, and conversion rate.

Title: Get Dashboard Chart Data
Description: Get chart data for the affiliate dashboard showing referral and visit trends over time. Useful for visualizing affiliate program performance.

Title: Get Commerce Reports
Description: Get commerce-specific reports for the affiliate program including revenue attributed to affiliates, top-performing affiliates, and product-level affiliate performance.

Title: Get Referral Configuration
Description: Get the current referral configuration including commission rates, referral types, cookie duration, and tracking settings.

Title: Update Referral Configuration
Description: Update referral configuration settings such as default commission rate, commission type (percentage or flat), cookie duration, and tracking preferences.

Title: Get Email Configuration
Description: Get the current email notification settings for the affiliate program: notification templates, triggers, and recipient configuration.

Title: Get Portal Stats
Description: Get affiliate portal statistics for the authenticated user: their total earnings, unpaid balance, referral count, visit count, and conversion rate.

Title: Get Portal Referrals
Description: Get the referral list from the affiliate portal perspective. Shows the affiliate their own referrals with status, amounts, and dates.

Title: Get Portal Transactions
Description: Get payout transactions from the affiliate portal perspective. Shows the affiliate their payment history including amounts, dates, and payment methods.
